name: M365 It Admin Library
description: Generate production-ready Microsoft 365 admin documentation. Seven generators covering Intune device configuration, Conditional Access policies, Defender for Endpoint triage, Exchange/Power Automate flow documentation, retention labels and information governance, security posture assessment, and onboard/offboard runbooks. Built for MSPs and internal IT teams managing M365 at scale who need audit-ready documentation in minutes instead of hours.
longDescription:
Ships **7 commands**.

- **Commands** (7): `conditional-access`, `defender-triage`, `flow-docs`, `intune-policy`, `onboard-offboard`, `retention-labels`, `security-posture`

Installs with `claude plugin install m365-it-admin-library@claude-community` from `DonteWong/claude-plugins-official` (`external_plugins/m365-it-admin-library`).

Production-Ready Documentation Generators for Intune, Defender, Entra ID, Purview & More
